cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(EventsScrapReference LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
add_application(EventsScrapProbe EventsScrapProbe.cc application.r CREATOR "ESRP")
target_compile_options(EventsScrapProbe PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)
add_application(InputProbe InputProbe.cc application.r CREATOR "ESRP")
target_compile_options(InputProbe PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)
